attribution: GTFS Scorecard (gtfsscorecard.org), scored on top of the MobilityData gtfs-validator

tiers.applies_to: feeds with measured realtime data, and any feed in the expiry danger or recovery window (expiring soon, or recently lapsed)
tiers.cadence: one direct liveness check every 3 hours
one direct liveness check in each 6-hour period, on a stable per-feed schedule that spreads requests across the period

statements: If a fetch fails, the last successful scorecard remains available. The pipeline recalculates only its calendar-based freshness and expiry fields. It never rewrites an older snapshot.
A feed whose calendar has been past its expiry date for more than 365 days is labeled 'stale' rather than 'lapsed', which changes how it is described but not whether it is served.
A configured feed URL is labeled 'unreachable' after 30 consecutive direct checks fail (roughly a week at standard cadence). This is separate from an expired calendar.
These observations do not guarantee an agency's GTFS host will stay online. The status page records what the pipeline observed and when.

description: The intended refresh cadence, current direct feed-URL liveness, and what happens when a feed cannot be refreshed on schedule.

refresh_success_record.measurement_note: Current share of feed records with no consecutive failed direct check; not a historical request-success rate. Records that carry no failure count are reported under not_measured and are left out of the share.

scope.note: Liveness statistics are restricted to feed records in the current published artifact index. Records outside that index are excluded.
